tests.name: json_view_nan_edit_self_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether a NaN written by an editable document json_view compares equal to itself.

tests.name: json_view_unedited_editable_self_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an unedited editable document root view still compares equal to itself correctly.

tests.name: json_view_readonly_nan_check
tests.intent: Probes equality behavior for read-only document views where NaN cannot be entered via parse.

tests.name: json_view_nan_array_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an array containing an edited NaN compares equal to itself or another view.

tests.name: json_view_nan_object_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an object containing an edited NaN compares equal to itself.

tests.name: json_view_infinity_edit_equality
tests.intent: Probes whether an infinity written by an edit still compares equal to itself.

tests.name: json_view_mixed_nan_and_normal_floats
tests.intent: Probes equality of arrays containing both normal numbers and an edited NaN.

tests.name: json_view_compare_with_standard_json_nan
tests.intent: Probes comparison between an editable view containing an edited NaN and a standard json object holding NaN.

tests.name: json_view_push_back_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes equality when a NaN is pushed back into an editable view array.

tests.name: json_view_insert_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes equality when a NaN is inserted into an editable view array.

tests.name: json_view_nested_nan_containers
tests.intent: Probes equality of nested containers where a deeply nested value is an edited NaN.

tests.name: json_view_multiple_nan_nodes
tests.intent: Probes comparison of a document with multiple edited NaN fields against itself.

tests.name: json_view_floats_equal_helper_nan
tests.intent: Probes direct float equality checks using views containing edited NaNs.

tests.name: json_view_editable_copy_assignment_nan
tests.intent: Probes equality after copying or modifying editable document views with NaNs.

tests.name: json_view_editable_materialize_nan
tests.intent: Probes materialization of an editable document view containing a NaN.

tests.name: json_view_negative_nan_edit
tests.intent: Probes whether a negative NaN or custom bit pattern NaN written via edit behaves consistently.

tests.name: json_view_integer_vs_edited_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes comparison between an integer node and an edited NaN node.

tests.name: json_view_string_vs_edited_nan_equality
tests.intent: Probes comparison between a string node and an edited NaN node.

tests.name: json_view_editable_document_patch_nan
tests.intent: Probes behavior when applying a patch or checking equality on an edited view with structural modifications.

tests.name: json_view_compare_different_editable_nan_docs
tests.intent: Probes comparison of two separately created editable documents both containing edited NaNs.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises same_float with std::false_type via comparison of two read-only document views containing float values.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises same_float with std::true_type via comparison of two editable document views containing unedited float values.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises certainly_equal node-identity shortcut with editable documents that have never been edited.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises floats_equal with an editable view of a NaN assigned via set() and compared against another view or float.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises float_token_is_nan and number_float lockstep comparison where an editable document with an edit is compared via operator==.
